Join our team as a warehouse employee at a renowned fashion store located in the heart of The Hague. You can work between 3 to 32 hours per week, making it an ideal job to complement your other commitments. Earn €14.99 per hour while being part of an enthusiastic team. Enjoy flexible hours and seize growth opportunities that make this position particularly appealing!

Neem dan contact met ons op via: +31165326005 
 Waar ga je werken? 
As a warehouse employee at a renowned fashion store in the heart of The Hague, you will work between 3 to 32 hours per week. Your shifts are on Monday and Thursday mornings from 7:00 to 12:00 or in the afternoon from 16:00 to 19:00. This role is perfect for those seeking flexible work alongside other commitments. You will receive a competitive hourly wage and work in the vibrant city center. 
During your shift, you will assist in unpacking deliveries, sorting clothing and accessories, and ensuring everything is organized in the warehouse. You will also restock the store and maintain a tidy warehouse environment. You will work with a friendly team and have the ability to work independently. 
This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy staying active and working collaboratively. No experience is necessary-motivation and a positive attitu...

As a warehouse employee at a famous fashion store in the heart of The Hague, you work 3 to 32 hours per week. You work on Monday and Thursday mornings from 7:00 to 12:00 or in the afternoon from 16:00 to 19:00. This job is perfect if you want flexible work next to free time or another job. You receive a good hourly wage and work in the lively city center.

During your shift, you help unpack deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and make sure everything ends up in the right place in the warehouse. You restock the store and keep the warehouse tidy. You work with a friendly team and can also work independently.

This position is suitable for anyone who likes to stay active and enjoys working with others. No experience is needed—motivation and a positive attitude are most important. Do you want to help keep the store organized and be part of a diverse team? Apply now! ✨

- At least VMBO (secondary education) working and thinking level

- Experience is not required, but is a plus

- Able to work independently and in a team

- Physically fit and proactive

- You speak Dutch or English

Are you an experienced operator and would you like to work with fresh products in a clean and modern production environment? Apply now and join the team at an international production company in the Deurne region!

What will you do?
As an operator, you are responsible for a smooth production process. You make sure the machines are set correctly and that problems are solved quickly. You work closely with your team and guide colleagues when needed.

Your tasks will include:

- Setting up and starting production lines
- Monitoring the production process and product quality
- Solving small machine problems or calling the technical service
- Arranging the supply of raw materials
- Performing quality checks and HACCP registrations
- Supervising production workers on your line

As an operator:

- You have experience as an operator or in production
- You have a good level of Dutch or English
- You live in the region of Eindhoven, Helmond, Weert, Veldhoven, Deurne or Venray

Are you ready for a logistics job with job security and opportunities to grow? At CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk, you will work as a Logistics Employee in a modern warehouse where teamwork and quality are important. You will gain valuable logistics experience and have the opportunity to develop yourself through training courses. Interested? Apply today!

Your tasks may include:

    - Inspecting products and returned goods
    
- Processing and registering goods in the warehouse management system
    
- Working with a computer or tablet for administrative tasks
    
- Following work instructions and quality procedures

What’s in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €14.99
    
- Travel allowance according to the client's reimbursement scheme
    
- Full-time employment
    
- Temporary employment contract with the possibility of a direct contract with the client when performing well
    
- A long-term position with growth opportunities
    
- Pension accrual through Manpower
    
- Free access to more than 200 online training courses via the Manpower Academy
    
- An international working environment with colleagues from diverse backgrounds

    - Good command of the English language, both spoken and written
    
- Basic skills in working with computers or tablets
    
- Ability to spend most of the working day standing
    
- Availability for a full-time position (40 hours per week)

Would you like to start working as a Logistics Employee at CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk? Click the apply button today and find out if this logistics opportunity matches your ambitions. We look forward to receiving your application!

At DHL you will find yourself in a friendly and close-knit team. In addition, you can count on a gross salary of €15.12 per hour for your work in the warehouse, pension accrual via Manpower and, if you perform well, the chance of a takeover by DHL. Do you want to know more about this position? Read the entire vacancy and apply today!

For DHL in Eindhoven, employment agency Manpower is looking for several warehouse employees.

As a warehouse employee, you are responsible for the following activities:

    - Picking and preparing orders for shipment
    
- Processing goods and products with a hand scanner
    
- Sorting incoming goods
    
- Processing data in the various automatic systems
    
- Supporting various warehouse and packaging activities

What’s in it for you

    - Full-time job of 40 hours per week
    
- Gross salary of €15.12 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of up to €14.85 per day (starting at one kilometre)
    
- Shift allowance of 35% for working after 21.00
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower

You will also have the opportunity to develop yourself via the Manpower Academy. Here you can, for example, obtain a Vca certificate or follow training courses for your personal growth. This is just a selection of all the options.

    - Own transport (the work location is not accessible by public transport during working hours)
    
- Eighteen years or older (due to the varying working hours)
    
- Good command of the Dutch and/or English language (in connection with safety instructions and English as the working language in the warehouse)
    
- Physically able to lift, walk and stand a lot
    
- Availability of 40 hours per week
    
- Able to provide a VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct)

Do you meet the job requirements and are you interested in this position? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

You start your shift at 08:00 in the Hoofddorp warehouse. Using an aerial platform (hoogwerker) that takes you up into the high racking systems, you gather products from elevated locations. On occasion, you also drive a reachtruck to transport pallets and organize stock. At 17:00, your shift ends and the day's orders are ready for shipment.
 Tasks  -  Pick products at high elevations using an aerial platform
 
 -  Drive an aerial platform safely up into high warehouse racks
 
 -  Operate a reachtruck occasionally to move pallets and stock
 
 -  Scan picked items using handheld scanners
 
 -  Pack products securely into shipping boxes
 
 -  Perform basic quality and quantity checks on collected orders
 
 -  Keep your work area and picking aisles clean and safe
 
 
 What we are looking for  -  Adequate command of the English language
 
 -  Available from Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00
 
 -  Comfortable working at heights on aerial platforms (no fear of heights)
 
 -  Experience driving a reachtruck is a plus (certificate is not required)
 
 -  Accurate and safety-conscious work attitude
 
 
 What we offer  -  Hourly wage of €15.06
 
 -  Travel allowance
 
 -  29 holiday days per year
 
 -  8% holiday allowance
 
 -  Flexible or weekly payout options via Staffice
 
 -  Personal guidance from your Staffice coordinator
 
 -  A pleasant working atmosphere is guaranteed.
 
 
 Why Staffice?  -  Personal approach and direct communication
 
 -  Fast onboarding process so you can start quickly
 
 -  Reliable service with clear and honest agreements
 
 
 This vacancy in Hoofddorp is also interesting if you live in Haarlem, Schiphol, or Amsterdam. We look at your skills and help you obtain certificates if needed.
 Ben je nog steeds enthousiast over deze vacature in de logistiek? Reageer dan nu en wij nemen snel contact met je op. Heb je vragen? Bel ons gerust via 085-0600565.

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver / Reach Truck Driver Arvato in Heijen (234107)
jobs.description:
Do you have a valid Dutch work permit and do you have experience operating a forklift or reach truck? Then this position is for you. In this role, you are an important link in the logistics process and ensure that goods are handled, stored and shipped safely and efficiently. You will work in an open and pleasant working environment where teamwork and accuracy are key. In addition, you have the chance of a contract upon good performance. Read on!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for Forklift Drivers / Reach Truck Drivers for Arvato in Heijen.

As a forklift or reach truck driver, you will work in different departments within the warehouse, such as inbound, assembly and outbound. This keeps your tasks varied and diverse.

Your tasks include:

    - Receiving, inspecting, and scanning goods and pallets
    
- Moving, palletizing, and processing goods using a forklift
    
- Picking orders for assembly and shipment
    
- Packing, labeling, and preparing orders for dispatch
    
- Loading trucks according to loading schedules
    
- Identifying discrepancies and reporting malfunctions
    
- Performing general warehouse duties using forklifts and reach trucks

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower with the chance of being hired directly upon good performance
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer’s policy
    
- Possibility to work 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Shift allowance or overtime compensation (when applicable)
    
- A varied position within a modern logistics working environment📦

    - In possession of a forklift or reach truck certificate
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- Reliable and honest, able to keep agreements
    
- Flexible regarding working hours and overtime
    
- Able to work accurately with attention to detail
    
- Proactive and willing to help colleagues when needed
    
- Good physical condition and no physical complaints
    
- Willing to apply for a Certifica

As a warehouse employee in Venlo, you work for a major logistics provider. You work full-time, 32 to 40 hours per week, in 2 shifts: morning (06:00-15:00) or afternoon (15:00-00:00). During busy periods, you may also work a night shift (21:00-06:00). You get a fixed schedule, but sometimes work extra or on weekends. This makes the job varied and challenging!
On a typical workday, you pick orders, pack products, and check quality. You load and unload goods and work with hand scanners and computer systems. You work together with colleagues in a friendly team and help keep the warehouse tidy and safe.
You enjoy an active job and pay attention to quality. You learn quickly and want to grow in logistics. Want to work at a company that values your efforts? Apply now and join our team! 🚀

- You have at least VMBO or MBO level

- You speak basic English

- No experience required, but logistics experience is a plus

- You are flexible and fine with working in shifts

- You enjoy working in a team

- You are accurate and involved

- You think in solutions and want to learn

- You live within 50 km of Venlo

Have you always wanted to work with cool LED lighting from Philips? Then we have good news for you! At Signify in Eindhoven, we are looking for a part-time Logistics Employee. You will be working on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, so you'll have plenty of time left over for fun activities or possibly another job for the rest of the week! Read quickly, then I'll tell you more about this amazing job opportunity.#baanrader

What we offer
- A Start salary of € 14.99 per hour!
- A premium of 8.14%
- Chances for a permanent contract!
- A standard day off on your birthday
- Reachable via many means of transport!
- A load of growth possibilities!

Who you are
As a part-time order picker, you must meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch or English
- You are available on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday
- You can work in 2 shifts
- You can work in Eindhoven, in the area around Flight Forum
- You have the right to work in the Netherlands

What will you do
You will be our hero with a Voice pick system and an OPT. It’s a mix of small and light boxes. There is some heavier work at times—but the OPT will help you with that. Your task? Ensuring that orders are perfectly prepared for our customers. No day is the same! The work is varied, and we promise that you won’t have a dull moment at Signify Eindhoven.

- Order picking
- Packing
- Quality Control

Where will you work
Welcome to Signify, the place for innovative LED lighting systems from the world-famous Philips brand! Our logistics center in Eindhoven is the place to be. Not just for processing products, but for creating a vibrant atmosphere as well. Here, everything revolves around teamwork, efficiency, and a touch of fun. You'll be part of a dynamic environment where every day brings a new challenge. With modern technologies and a passionate team, we make a difference. Ready to be part of our inspiring story?

- Employer with a great reputation
- Opportunities for growth and a permanent contract
- A fantastic team

More than 1,200 companies worldwide run their day on Uptick, using it to inspect, maintain, and protect over 3 million buildings and 40 million pieces of fire & life safety equipment across Australia, the UK and Ireland, and North America. More than 22,000 people open Uptick first thing in the morning and work in it all day, so we make it fast, intuitive, and reliable, and we back it with a customer team that knows the industry inside out. You will join a fast-paced, dog-friendly scaleup, working alongside people who care about the work and each other. The opportunity: We're opening up new European markets, and we're looking for the first Implementation Manager dedicated to Benelux. You'll onboard and upskill on our product working closely with our UK Implementation team, then quickly become the go-to person for Dutch-speaking customers. As the region grows, we expect this role to grow into regional leadership. Several people on our current implementation team have already made that move internally. This role requires fluent Dutch in addition to English, plus regular travel to Benelux. You'll be based in London, with relocation offered for the right candidate. What you will own Data migration. Support customers with the collation, extraction, cleansing, and import of their data into Uptick using Excel and Google Sheets. System configuration. Configure customer workspaces to suit their internal workflows and industry requirements. Product training. Train the customer's team to use Uptick in their daily roles, driving strong adoption across our core modules in the critical phase after go live. Project management. Deliver implementation projects on time, keeping momentum so customers have the best chance of adopting Uptick successfully. Data and systems.
